findings.locator: June 2026 document filed July 6, PDF pages 6–12 / printed pages 1–7, sections 1–3
findings.finding: Final plan provides proposed 178,000-square-foot mixed-use redevelopment, prior soil findings, tank-area investigation and potential interim measures. Later than the March fact sheet which left redevelopment undetermined.

findings.finding: Refinery-related storage/fueling history, petroleum soil and groundwater impacts, localized PAHs, and limited selected lead analyses. Two of four sampled temporary wells had VOC standard exceedances.
findings.limit: Recommendation to pursue spill closure requires remediation; no closure established. Historical occupants are not automatically the source of each measured compound. Two soil lead analyses do not characterize the entire site.

findings.finding: DEC transmits the fully executed Brownfield Cleanup Agreement.
findings.limit: Acceptance is a process milestone, not remediation completion.

findings.locator: PDF pages 6–9, 14–15, 18–19 / sections 1, 4.2, 6; PDF page 14 visually reviewed
findings.finding: 1952–1956 pilot research history, brine and demolition fill, affected creek sediment and soils, consolidation and cover, May 2025–May 2026 monitoring. MW-2 spring 2026 mercury 16.3 micrograms/L and beta-BHC 0.22 micrograms/L exceeded report comparison standards. Surface-water discharge samples also had specified exceedances. Operator reports effective hydraulic containment and no new exposure pathways.
findings.limit: Operator-submitted report is not a separate DEC concurrence. Its general favorable conclusion must not erase specific exceedances. Groundwater and surface-water discharge sampling are not drinking-water sampling. Older and newer documents use differing OU labels; retain document-specific maps.

findings.finding: Legacy EPA entry confirms a federal inventory identity and no further federal action status, but lists a coordinate conflicting with DEC's Niagara Falls cleanup location.
findings.limit: Use DEC GIS point 932050. Federal NFFA/NFRAP is not state cleanup completion or absence of contamination.
